rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying there is more than enough of something.

example.english: There is plenty of parking space here.
example.jyutping: nei1 dou6 daai6 baa2 wai2 paak3 ce1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a large or more-than-adequate amount.

example.english: This shop has plenty of kinds of cake.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭有好多款蛋糕。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 jau5 hou2 do1 fun2 daan6 gou1

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression for emphatic plenty, especially with resources such as time, money, or opportunities.

example.english: Don’t worry so much—we still have plenty of time.
example.traditional: 唔使咁擔心，我哋仲有大把時間。
example.jyutping: m4 sai2 gam3 daam1 sam1 ngo5 dei6 zung6 jau5 daai6 baa2 si4 gaan3
